preconditions.description: The number of rows in the tables is between 1 and 1500, inclusive.
The number of columns in the tables is between 1 and 1500, inclusive.
Each element in table A is between 1 and n, inclusive.
Each element in table B is between 1 and n, inclusive.

postconditions.expression: output == -1 or (0 <= k <= 5000 and all(1 <= c_i <= m for c_i in columns))
postconditions.description: The output is -1 if it is not possible to transform A into B, otherwise it is a non-negative integer k followed by k integers representing the columns to sort by.

postconditions.expression: output == -1 or (exists(sequence of columns C such that applying sortings by columns C to A results in B))
postconditions.description: There exists a sequence of columns C such that applying sortings by columns C to A results in B.
